question: What is the monthly rate for a Principal Consultant?
gold_answer: Rs 4,54,000 excluding taxes (05-10-2023). The 2018 rate was Rs 3,24,000

gold_grs_detail.title: Regarding Empanelment of Consultants for IT Projects in Government of Maharashtra.

product.answer: The monthly rate for a Principal Consultant under the 20-03-2018 GR is INR 3,24,000 per month per person (excluding taxes). The 05-10-2023 GR revises this rate to INR 4,54,000 per month per person (excluding taxes) for the newly empaneled period from 20-09-2023 to 19-09-2028.
